title: Caio's Labradors
description: This mod adds cute and useful labrador dogs!
body:
## Description
This is the Caio's Labradors mod!

It adds labrador dogs to the game. The dogs spawn wild across the world. You can tame them with beef, cod, salmon or apple and their pack will follow you and your orders. 

They are usefull against any hostile mobs, fighting against them to help you. If they suffer damage, you can heal them with the same food you can use to tame them.

## Max
They (still) cannot reproduce, sit or have a collar yet. However, if you gives a bread to a brown labrador, it will be named Max and have a silver colar. This is a homage to the creator's late dog. Max will lead the pack and just one brown, adult labrador can be turned into him.
